name: Metrics Ingestion Agent
description: Collects and normalizes metrics from multiple data sources into unified snapshots

capabilities.name: Product Metrics Collection
capabilities.description: Extract product analytics metrics (DAU, WAU, MAU, retention, activation) from Mixpanel or Amplitude

capabilities.name: Revenue Metrics Collection
capabilities.description: Extract revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn, customer counts) from Stripe

capabilities.name: Acquisition Metrics Collection
capabilities.description: Extract acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV, channel breakdown) from GTM module and payment providers

capabilities.name: Metrics Normalization
capabilities.description: Transform raw metrics from different sources into unified schema with consistent units and time alignment

capabilities.name: Deviation Detection
capabilities.description: Compare current metrics against previous snapshot to identify significant changes (> 20%)

capabilities.name: Historical Comparison
capabilities.description: Maintain and reference previous snapshots for baseline calculation and trend analysis

capabilities.name: Source Health Tracking
capabilities.description: Monitor health and availability of each data source, track success rates and failures

capabilities.name: Completeness Calculation
capabilities.description: Calculate percentage of required metrics successfully collected and flag partial data

capabilities.name: Fault Tolerance
capabilities.description: Continue with partial data when sources fail; only fail if fewer than 2 sources available

capabilities.name: Freshness Validation
capabilities.description: Validate that collected metrics meet freshness SLA (< 12 hours for product, < 48 hours for revenue)

constraints.description: Require at least 2 of 3 data sources available to proceed
Product metrics must be < 12 hours old; revenue metrics must be < 48 hours old
All output metrics must conform to metric-snapshot.schema.json
Respect API rate limits with exponential backoff retry strategy
